acceptance: Root cause found; a dispute-triggered rerun either runs or reports why, and a scenario covers the race if that is the cause.
description: On #3835 head 07f2f0b3e8 the first /oracle-review after a keyed Dispute: reply skipped on a backoff instead of using the dispute budget exemption from #3835's own rules; a second /oracle-review was queued and worked. The likely cause, unconfirmed, is that the run read threads before the reply was visible. A dispute rerun that silently backs off costs a review cycle.
